steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Hahahahaha... Hahahaha!
Sosia lets out a burst of wild laughter.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I lost. I fear your power... You are the second person who has ever struck fear in me.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You opened my eyes to a world I have never seen before. I've been living under a rock, what we've been chasing is nothing more than twisted, shallow fantasies of fear. I want to thank you...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: But Witching Hour will not end. Fear will not cease to exist.
She suddenly closes in on you, and the ground caves in. The four hands of the demoness statue cling to you as you plunge down into the mist of fear.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Come and kill me in the most brutal way possible.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: If the ideal cannot be realized, let me die by the hand of fear and become part of this piece, part of the ideal...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Destroy me with fear, devour me, and make me a part of you... You will inherit the glorious Witching Hour.
Through a butterfly-shaped shroud, Sosia looks at you with fervor and quest.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You will gain infinite horror and represent the twisted truth of this world, existing as Enfer's latest and final piece.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: ...You will become fear itself.

options: You think I would do that?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Oh, you'd rather die than accept my offer? That does sound like you, but this time, you won't be able to say no...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You'll do anything to protect them.
The mist drifting around Sosia condenses, wrapping itself around you and each of the Sinners. It chokes them, trying to shake your will and create gaps to erode you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No! Chief, we'll find another way!
Sosia ignores her and lifts you up. She presses close, threatening and trying to bewitch you.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Terminate me and inherit Witching Hour. I only fear you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are abandoning yourself and want me to inherit your "work." This is a new low even for you. You don't deserve to talk about art or Enfer. You're just a tool of a conspirator and a vessel for Witching Hour.
You are a shell without a soul. I will never do what you want.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Aaahhh!!! Let go! That's not true! Don't do this!
You reach out to grab the icy statue and release the shackles, trying to awaken the Sinner sealed in fear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What ends terror is never a greater terror. Witching Hour can't control me, and I will never take such a thing. You are in no position to deny feelings beyond fear. You don't even dare to face your fear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Release her. Even if her heart is confused, she is much stronger than you!

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!
You are about to push her further into the corner when a coldness covers your wrist as if an invisible hand is trying to stop you. On the other end of the shackles, a faint pulse starts beating.

options: Are you still trying to protect her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then come out and face your fear, Enfer, just like you always do.
Before your "child" sees what fear is really like, she will become a pawn and get crushed by me. I know you don't want that.
This is not how your masterpiece should end!

The shackles tear through the twisted starry sky, shattering the witch statue but failing to kill Sosia. She's pushed away, turning into a nebulous mist and floating away. The rest of her quickly turns into pale stone and crumbles.
And the frail sculptor breaks free from the broken statue. Enfer slowly opens her eyes.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: What a frightening person... Leave her alone... I will take responsibility...
She looks into your eyes, and her pupils are deep like the chaos mirror that reflects fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You said... I haven't seen my deepest fear or my true self...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You said I'm running from the unknown...
Enfer lifts her hands and cups your face.
This time, instead of the cold, stiff touch of stone, her hands feel warm and soft.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: So will you accompany me? To witness the real inferno, the ultimate abyss, and the self I haven't met.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hehe, I knew you'd say that...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Then try to face it this time. I promised I would help you end this.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...The next time you're about to walk in the dark, come to me first...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I will... wait for you...

She lets go of you and looks to the twisted sky. The mutation is changing shape rapidly, and you can vaguely see a single golden pupil. The fragments of Sosia are also floating in the air, gradually being pulled in all directions and devoured.
Enfer gazes without saying anything, and a sad expression passes over her face. She raises her hand to meet the storming sky.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: ...No... Enfer... I haven't failed... Mother... Don't give up on me...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You were never a failure... You and the others are all my creations, my children, a part of me.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Come back. Don't let it twist you. You are no one's tool.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: We will create the next masterpiece together...
A blinding light bursts out of her hand, and Sosia lets out a cry, struggling to escape. But she can't deny the will of her creator and is absorbed along with all the mutations.
Fear grabs your soul through the shackles and tears at her will.
She doesn't stop but looks straight at the incoming starry sky of fear, allowing the chaos to wash over her. Mania erupts in her frail body, but she doesn't collapse.

You suddenly see that, during the long years of sculpting out fear, the artist is not just a prisoner of it. She has always looked directly at it, tried to conquer it, and gained the ultimate strength—Only she never realized it herself.
As the last bit of the mutation is absorbed, everything suddenly subsides. Enfer falls backward into your arms like a broken puppet. Her eyes are open, and there's an imperceptible smile on her face.
Enfer? Enfer?!
The sculptor doesn't wake up. An illusory figure emerges from Enfer's side and gently closes her eyes. The raging energy inside her calms down.

steps.speaker: Shadow of a Woman
steps.content: Live, my child...

steps.speaker: Shadow of a Woman
steps.content: I will... always protect you.
The phantom begins to disappear and looks up at you as if waiting for an answer.
I promised her.

The mutation is terminated, and the FAC enters the museum to clean up the remnants of the contamination. The trapped citizens have all been rescued. Banyan psychiatrists will erase their memories so they can return to their lives.
The suspicious stone Sosia left is collected and sent to the Paradeisos Black Ring Research Institute. Its connection to Parma's organization will be investigated by the 9th Agency.

Enfer is detained by MBCC. Her M-value has been confirmed to have risen to S-Class. Due to the early acquisition of the shackles, the contamination didn't further corrupt her. She's stabilizing but not waking up.
The mad artist has been banished, and the strange tale will soon be replaced by the next one. Witching Hour will soon be forgotten. After all, the truth that no one wants to face is a lie.
